newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia c.bank Sept foreign currency reserves up.
newsitem.headline: Estonia c.bank Sept foreign currency reserves up.

text.p: The Estonian central bank on Tuesday said that its net gold and foreign currency reserves rose to 7.2 billion kroons in September from 6.9 billion kroons at the end of August.

It also said in its September balance sheet statement that notes and coins in circulation came to 4.69 billion kroons last month after 4.66 billion in August, which it said reflected a recovery in increased demand for cash.
It said that its total assets grew to 8.37 billion kroons in September from 8.06 billion in August.
